name: Timbermaw Hold
summary: Within Timbermaw Hold, a furbolg tribe still resists demonic corruption. Its tunnels link Felwood, Moonglade, and Winterspring.

sections.title: A Sanctuary Amidst Decay
sections.body: Deep beneath the mountain, the Timbermaw guard their home while corruption spreads through the forests above. During the Third War, the Burning Legion tainted neighboring furbolg tribes, but the Timbermaw endured in these stone corridors. From below, they watched their beloved forests warp. Now they distrust outsiders and defend every tunnel entrance, expecting violence from anyone coming in from the infected woods.

sections.title: Crossroads of the North
sections.body: Timbermaw Hold is the only direct passage through the mountain between Felwood, Moonglade, and Winterspring. Its sentries let outsiders pass only after they prove their goodwill. Those who oppose the corrupted furbolg clans may find steadfast allies among the Timbermaw. They share their ancient shamanic knowledge and leathercrafting traditions.

faq.q: Why do the furbolgs in Timbermaw Hold attack visitors?
faq.answer: The Timbermaw distrust outsiders after seeing neighboring kin succumb to the Burning Legion’s corruption. They fear strangers may bring the taint into their home or be mistaken for feral, demonic furbolgs. So they attack until visitors prove peaceful intentions.

faq.q: Which zones does Timbermaw Hold connect?
faq.answer: Timbermaw Hold connects Felwood, Moonglade, and Winterspring. Its main cavern opens to northern Felwood in the southwest, Moonglade to the north, and Winterspring to the east. A walled-off gate also lies in northern Azshara.

faq.q: How did the Timbermaw survive the Legion's taint?
faq.answer: The Timbermaw sheltered deep in their mountain caverns while demonic fel energy withered Felwood’s forests. During the height of the demonic invasion, they sealed themselves inside the hold. This preserved their minds and sacred shamanic ways while neighboring clans fell to madness.

faq.q: What is the sealed wooden door inside the hold?
faq.answer: A round wooden barrier blocks a side cavern deeper in the tunnels. Its purpose is uncertain, though travelers think it may seal older tunnel complexes leading toward the Barrow Deeps or other ancient chambers beneath Mount Hyjal.

angles.text: As a druid, you can travel through the hold between your sacred sanctuary in Moonglade and wounded Felwood. Furbolg spirits there need cleansing.
As a shaman, you can see how the Timbermaw have kept their spiritual traditions and healing rituals uncorrupted despite the fel corruption outside their cave gates.
